identity_policy: Roasters: exact normalized name plus documented domain. Beans: exact resolved roaster, full name including crop, and product source URL. No fuzzy, token, URL-only, or cross-crop matching. Runtime repeats ownership and identity guards.

exclusions.reason: Generic V60 schedule repeats 240 g at 1:30 then labels the drain 300 g; missing 60 g pouring action is not repaired by assumption. Generic Origami summary says 280 g while its schedule ends at 285 g. Repeated generic method blocks across all six coffees are not multiplied into distinct coffee-specific recipes.
Coffee process omitted because summary says Washed but narrative discusses a natural coffee in the blend. Filter/espresso parameters themselves are internally usable.
Coffee process omitted because summary and process section say Dry Washed while abstract calls it a natural lot. No caffeine numbers imported from zero-valued template sections.
French Press omitted: header gives 50 g dose but numbered instructions give 45 g. Espresso is separately included.
Coffee Maker omitted: 30 g coffee / 900 g water conflicts with displayed 1:15 ratio. Dwell recipes are not relabeled as a supported V60 method.
Official page explicitly says it does not post definitive brew guides for specific coffees. General 1:2 / ~24 s guidance not duplicated as bean-specific records.
Public URL now returns HTTP 404; not imported from stale third-party copies.
Public URL now returns HTTP 404.
Public fetch returned HTTP 403; no access-control bypass or invented complete recipe.
Only generic 1:16 / 3–4 min brewing guidance, repeated across coffees. Not counted as a distinct detailed bean-specific recipe.
Only generic 1:16 / 3–4 min brewing guidance, repeated across coffees. Not counted as a distinct detailed bean-specific recipe.
Toddy guide provides 283 g / 1750 g at 80°F and 1050 µm but no steep duration in retrieved instructions. Held out of executable recipes rather than inventing overnight time.
Coffee-only chilled concentrate is now included once as pour_over. Cocktail ingredients and alcoholic or zero-proof mixed-drink recipes are not imported.
404; replaced with live /coffee-inf-recipes/kayon-mountain and product page.
404; historical search text is not imported as a current recipe.
SP Costa Rica association excluded: product says washed; farm recipe data says yellow honey. Other explicit Volcan SL28 espresso is retained.
Filter recipe timing conflict: prose second pour 35 seconds, table 30 seconds. Only espresso imported. Variety retained as Krume because numeric identifier differs between product and farm data.
404; historical recipe retained with image_url null; no logo substituted.
Usable general competition recipe but exact coffee identity is not established in article text; deferred in favor of coffee-specific 2022 source.
404; excluded.
404; excluded.
Churupallana Mugen Switch entry deferred: volume-unit schedule and valve-state wording need source clarification; no invented g conversions.
The captured official guide publishes 212 seconds for 20.3 g → 44 g espresso at 93.5°C. This suspicious value is excluded; it has not been silently changed to 21 or 22 seconds.
Same-name Risaralda Washed rows disagree (21.5 g → 48 g / 30 s versus 21.5 g → 44 g / 28 s); the Veer Attikan row lists 9.5°C. These rows are excluded without correction.
General espresso table gives 29 s; product recipe gives 30 s at the same 22 g → 44 g / 94.5°C.
General table gives 22 g → 44 g / 29 s / 95°C; product gives 22 g → 44 g / 30 s / 94.5°C.
General table gives 21.5 g → 48 g / 29 s; product gives 22 g → 44 g / 30 s, both at 94.5°C.
Umoja Natural table gives 21 g → 42 g / 26 s / 95°C; captured natural-product recipe gives 21.5 g → 42 g / 28 s / 94.5°C. This is distinct from the included Umoja Washed.
Recipe heading has no usable dose, output, time or temperature in the captured page; metadata image filename also refers to a filter version. No parameters were invented.
Only an espresso ratio of 1:2.5 was captured; no coffee dose, time or temperature. Not included as a complete actionable recipe.
Brunswick card has exactly the same 24 g / 26 s and roast-age yields as Broadway. Both named coffees are retained, with a single canonical Broadway/Brunswick recipe.

Fritz current basket-area formulas and flow-dependent times differ from older named-blend basket tables. For example Old Dog older 18 g basket advice uses 16–17 g → 40–44 g, while the current formulas yield 34–38 g at those doses. No silent choice of guide version was made.
Article names two coffees and gives 200 g in 40+60+50+50 g pours, but omits coffee dose, water temperature and final time. Missing values were not borrowed from the May recipe.
Method guide blocks are reused on multiple product pages; not counted as additional uniquely coffee-specific recipes in this curated batch.

Located locale-specific generic ORIGAMI instructions differ (English 14.5 g / 260 g / four pours versus Japanese 15 g / 240 g / three pours); this research did not establish a single matching coffee-specific variant.
